searchText: Hi, I have a question. I'm trying to retrieve data related to confirmed deposits and consolidations from the beacon layer. I've tried accessing the API at http://hoodi:8545/eth/v2/beacon/blocks/1778303, but it's not returning any consolidation data; the returned field values ​​are all empty: ``` "execution_requests": { "deposits": [], "withdrawals": [], "consolidations": [] } ```

excerpts.content:
Hi, I have a question. I'm trying to retrieve data related to confirmed deposits and consolidations from the beacon layer. I've tried accessing the API at http://hoodi:8545/eth/v2/beacon/blocks/1778303, but it's not returning any consolidation data; the returned field values ​​are all empty:
```
"execution_requests": {
    "deposits": [],
    "withdrawals": [],
    "consolidations": []
}
```
